thread:
maria: FYI main pipeline turned red after my merge. gateway-integration-tests timed out 10m in :grimacing:
ci-bot: Build 7077778888 - https://ci.redwood.example/7077778888 - Failed - step: gateway-integration-tests (timeout)
devon: pinging @maria since you authored that merge, any idea?
maria: saw the alert, will look. the change touched gateway test harness but only tiny tweak to header ordering.
sam: @devon can you grab first pass? I might be in meetings for a bit.
devon: yeah picking it up. maria could you paste the failing test name/log snippet?
maria: sure — failing test: `TestGatewayLargePayloadStream`
```
--- FAIL: TestGatewayLargePayloadStream (600.03s)
    stream_test.go:142: context deadline exceeded
```
ci-bot: Attached logs: https://ci.redwood.example/7077778888/logs/gateway/stream_test.log
oncall-jen: when in doubt, rerun first to see if it's a transient env flake. @ci-bot can you /rerun pipeline 7077778888 ?
ci-bot: Received rerun request from oncall-jen. Scheduling rebuild (attempt 2).
maria: thanks j, I also ran the test locally with `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT=900s` and it passed. suspect env jitter or infra.
devon: ok holding off on bisect until rerun finishes. if it fails again, we should bisect commit range 7077760000..7077778888 (approx).
sam: quick question — did your change touch the mock server or just headers?
maria: only headers ordering; mock server unchanged. but the test spins up a real net listener which could race.
ci-bot: Rerun complete - Failed - same step timed out.
devon: repeating timeout means non-transient. @maria can you revert? or should we bisect to identify culprit?
maria: I don't want to revert blind. i can run a minimal bisect in my branch space. can someone kick off a narrower bisect?
oncall-jen: I'll start a bisect job using the `fast-bisect` script. posting results here when ready.
devon: also flagging infra: gateway test uses external port allocation; could be flakier under load. maybe we should gate port overlaps earlier.
sam: can you add a quick flaky-annotate to the test so it doesn't block main while we root cause?
maria: I can add `t.SkipIfCI()` but prefer to bisect first.
ci-bot: Bisect job started: https://ci.redwood.example/bisect/7077778888-2
ci-bot: Bisect update: narrowed to single offending commit 7077777421 (author: lina) — suspected change: mock listener backoff behavior.
devon: aha, that commit looks unrelated at first glance but touches listener retry. @lina can you look?
maria: thanks for the bisect, that's huge. I will hold my merge until we confirm.
oncall-jen: @lina pinged. if it's indeed that commit we'll revert or patch quickly. For now adding main->blocked label and starting a short rollback play if needed. :lock: :warning:
ci-bot: Created rollback candidate PR: https://git.redwood.example/reverts/rc-7077778888
sam: perfect. whoever merges rollback, ping infra oncall to watch for downstream effects.
maria: will coordinate and open a follow-up to add stronger port isolation in tests.
devon: summary: rerun failed -> bisect pointed at 7077777421 -> @lina to triage -> rollback PR opened as mitigation. moving to troubleshooting channel for deeper root cause.
maria: thanks everyone, taking notes and will follow up once @lina posts findings. :thumbsup:
